properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency of the ethers v5 stack pulled in by hardhat-toolbox in the contract-deploy workspace; the application code itself uses ethers v6 (@noble/hashes) — no direct call site on hash.js in app code. Presence is the inventory question here: the shipped build contains these primitives.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here: the wallet demo components and hardhat workspace make direct use of secp256k1 via ethers. Migration is constrained by Ethereum protocol consensus (secp256k1 is fixed by the chain, not by this repo).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev/test-chain tooling dependency, not used by the tutorial site. It is a real weakness-class KDF (single-round MD5) present in the shipped dependency tree of the hardhat workspace.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev-toolchain dependency only (docusaurus dev server self-signed HTTPS certificate), not in the tutorial site's production bundle. node-forge also provides TLS 1.2/1.3, X.509 and PKCS infrastructure — quantum-unsafe RSA present in the dev environment's dependency tree. Same package as LIB-fe0eb9a4.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ethers v5 ECDSA signing path inside the hardhat workspace toolchain; the tutorial site itself runs ethers v6. Quantum-unsafe ECDSA shipped in the workspace's build; same library object as LIB-a0bfbc1a.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Capability of a shipped library: elliptic provides ECDH (key.getSharedSecret) among its primitives; no ECDH call site exists in the application code — the app uses ECDSA paths only. Recorded as a shipped capability, not an invoked one.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 is Ethereum's address/signature/event hash; fixed by protocol, not migratable within this repo. Also used directly by the tutorial's live components (docs/utils/Keccak256.tsx).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js is the KDF used by Ethereum keystore-file encryption (ethers Wallet.encrypt / json-wallets) and by the Web3 secret-storage spec; present in the workspace's dependency tree for wallet JSON encryption paths. Memory-hard KDF — not Shor-relevant, classical strength adequate at standard N parameters.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto library on disk in the hardhat workspace build; the app's own wallet demos call it indirectly through ethers v6's @noble/curves stack instead.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 is the alternative keystore-file KDF (Web3 secret storage spec, 262,144 iterations with HMAC-SHA-256) — present in the toolchain's crypto stack; no keystore operations in the app code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev-server HTTPS toolchain (docusaurus): selfsigned → node-forge generates a 2048-bit RSA keypair and X.509 self-signed certificate for local HTTPS. Not part of the production tutorial bundle. Same package as ALG-589856a1 (RSA).
